$description: Measured from cofounder.co and the public login wall at app.cofounder.co/os/login on 2026-11-21. The marketing site does not publish a named colour scale: paints come from computed styles. Tailwind theme variables that the bundle does declare are listed under core.tailwind and labelled as declared, not as the page palette.
